hypotheses.test: Spearman rho(PI, MDD_21) < 0 (primary) and rho(PI, RV_21) > 0 (secondary); one-sided
hypotheses.text: Higher PI precedes deeper forward drawdowns and higher realized vol.

hypotheses.test: Jonckheere-Terpstra trend test of MDD_21 across occupied bands LOW<MODERATE<ELEVATED<HIGH<CRISIS; bands with <60 states merged toward MODERATE; untestable if <2 bands remain
hypotheses.text: Regime bands are ordered: higher bands precede worse outcomes.

hypotheses.test: OLS MDD_21 ~ PI_z + UpTrans5 + ret_21 + ret_63 + RV_trailing_21; HAC Wald test on {PI_z, UpTrans5}; beta_PI < 0 required
hypotheses.text: PI level and upward regime transitions add information beyond trailing return/vol.

hypotheses.test: For each ruleB onset10 event: flagged if any state in [onset-63, trough] has PI >= 45; lead = onset - first flag (sessions); recall, precision (flag followed by onset within 63 sessions), false-alarm rate. Descriptive if <5 events.
hypotheses.text: Stress is flagged before or during deterioration.

inference.ci: 95% percentile bootstrap CIs for every reported statistic
inference.dependence: overlapping horizons: stationary block bootstrap (Politis-Romano), mean block length max(2h,21) sessions, 10,000 resamples, seed 20261004; regressions use Newey-West HAC with lag = ceil(1.5h)
inference.multipleTesting: Holm-Bonferroni across PM1-PM4 within each set, family alpha 0.05 one-sided; secondary/exploratory reported unadjusted and labelled
inference.sampleSize: report N states, N matured outcomes per horizon, N_eff = N/h (and Bartlett-adjusted), events count; any metric with N_eff < 30 is reported but cannot support PASS or FAIL

primary.metric: Jonckheere-Terpstra z for MDD_21 across bands
HAC Wald p-value and incremental R^2 of {PI_z, UpTrans5}
delta-rho = rho_FAULTLINE - rho_benchmark on MDD_21 vs (a) B11 equal-weight composite and (b) best single benchmark among B02-B10 (best chosen on the same data, which penalizes FAULTLINE)

secondary: rho and JT on RV_21, R_21, MDD_63, RV_63
E_h frequency by band with Wilson CIs

verdict.FAIL: In any set with N_eff >= 30: (a) PM1 or PM2 significant in the wrong direction; or (b) the 95% CI for rho(PI, MDD_21) lies entirely above -0.10 (effect economically negligible) and FAULTLINE does not beat B12 at p < 0.05; or (c) delta-rho vs B11 or vs the best single benchmark has a 95% CI entirely below 0.
verdict.MIXED-INCONCLUSIVE: Anything else, including: N_eff < 30; H2 untestable (fewer than 2 occupied bands); significant but below economic thresholds; passes C1 but not C2; beats null but not benchmarks.
verdict.PASS: In set C2 (live forward holdout) at its final checkpoint AND in set C1: PM1, PM2, PM3 significant after Holm in the predicted direction, each meeting its economic threshold, and PM4 delta-rho >= 0.05 against both B11 and the best single benchmark with 95% CI excluding 0, and FAULTLINE beats the B12 null at p < 0.05. N_eff >= 30 in each set. C1 alone can never yield PASS (in-sample-contaminated).

economicThresholds.mdd21GapHighVsLow: mean MDD_21 of states with PI>=45 at least 2.0 pp deeper than states with PI<45

verdict.reporting: Every verdict lists N, N_eff, events, point estimates, CIs, raw and Holm p-values for PM1-PM4 per set.
